account.note: RE-PULLED LIVE AT 13:22 ET BY THE 13:17 HOURLY AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD - AND THE FIRST ATTEMPT FAILED. The portfolio and equity-position calls BOTH returned HTTP 503 on the first try; they were retried once and both succeeded, and every number here comes from that successful live call rather than from the 12:21 read it happens to match. A connector failure answered from cache would be the run reasoning about positions from repo JSON as if it were live, which the rulebook forbids by name. The live figures: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the entire balance is settled and the whole of it is deployable. Unchanged from the 10:22, 11:21 and 12:21 reads because nothing has traded. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live and BOTH ARE EMPTY, so the board is FLAT and NO EXIT IS DUE: no target, no stop, no time stop, no option no-fly window closing today, and no straddle owed because item 3 binds only before an earnings hold. ZERO equity orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so agentTrades stays 0. THE BOARD CARRIES NO LIVE SPECIFICATION FOR A THIRD HOUR. why.json holds exactly one will entry dated today, the 09:48 FUTU limit, withdrawn at 11:21 by appending - so this run had no unexpired proposal to confirm or kill, and it verified that from the file rather than assuming it. THE WITHDRAWN LEVEL IS GRADED A THIRD TIME AND IT IS STILL GETTING WORSE: FUTU is 123.03 bid / 123.36 ask at 17:21:26.173573688Z, +9.14% against the 112.73 close, and the dead 117.90 limit is 5.13 under the bid against 4.85 an hour ago. It has still never traded since the 09:50-09:55 bar. On 3 shares that is 15.39 of gain not taken. BUT THE HOUR'S ACTUAL NEWS IS THAT THE COST OF REFUSING IS NOT MONOTONIC, AND SAYING SO MATTERS MORE THAN REPEATING THE HEADLINE. All four names ranked today remain above where this board declined them, yet TWO OF THE FOUR CAME BACK TOWARD THEIR REFUSAL PRICES THIS HOUR: TGT 163.13 bid against a 161.92 refusal, a 1.21 gap that was 2.19 at 12:21, and BJ 95.59 against 95.08, a 0.51 gap that was 0.95. The other two extended - ROST 241.26 against 238.38, now 2.88 against 1.77, and FUTU as above. A board that reported only the hour in which every refusal looked worst would be selecting its own evidence, so the narrowing is recorded as plainly as the widening was. No replacement is proposed and none is owed: the mid-session default is no trade, the bar mid-session is higher than at the open, and a name ticking back toward a level the board already declined is not a new reason to buy it - it is the AS row's answer five sessions running.

entryWatch.why: KILLED WHILE WINNING, WHICH IS THE ONLY CONDITION UNDER WHICH THE TEST MEANS ANYTHING. Every other limb still fails: the 114.92 day-2 higher low is untouched and nothing has printed below 116.83, the 112.73 close was never approached, the 108.47 stop is 13.54 below the bid, and the day-2 reclaim thesis has extended 4.34 beyond the 117.81 day-1 high it rested on. FUTU is the best-performing name this board ranked today. It dies anyway, because the only limb that ever applied to an away-side breach was limb two - the limit no longer inside the spread - and the 10:21 run refused to decide that off a single instant's quote, converting it into a tape test with a deadline and naming the 11:17 run as the one that would execute the answer. That run is this one and it was left no discretion. THE PRECEDENT IS CITED WITH ITS COST ATTACHED: the identical device fired on TGT at 14:22 on 8/20, this board honoured it, and the killed level then printed on fourteen of the nineteen bars afterwards - priced as sixty cents behind at 15:22, sixty-two cents in front at 15:36, and 2.18 behind on the official close. FUTU will probably grade worse, because unlike TGT it never came back at all, and that is written down BEFORE the outcome is in. THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED AND FUTU IS DEAD FOR TODAY AT ANY PRICE. Re-striking here would be the exact behaviour docs/RULES.md refuses most often, four hours after this board's own open run refused TGT at 161.92 on that same rule - and a rule honoured only against names this board does not own is not a rule.

entryWatch.setup: TGT day-3 continuation at a new 52-week high - the best structure and the best liquidity on the board today, REFUSED on the chase rule
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED AT 161.92 BID, WHICH IS 2.56 ABOVE THE LEVEL THIS BOARD KILLED YESTERDAY. TGT is 161.92 bid / 162.37 ask at 13:45:52.660Z, last 162.36, +2.32% against the 158.25 settled close, on a 0.278% spread. It set a NEW 52-WEEK HIGH of 162.205 this morning and its structure is the cleanest here - three ascending session lows at 146.21, 154.50 and 160.23. The dead level is the 159.36 limit withdrawn by appending at 14:22 yesterday, and it is NOT revived. RE-GRADED AT 12:21: TGT is 164.11 bid / 164.19 ask at 16:22:17.22369506Z, +3.70% against the 158.25 close - 2.19 above the 161.92 this board refused at 09:46 and 4.75 above the 159.36 level it killed yesterday, which is 9.50 on the 2 shares that specification carried. THE REFUSAL IS COSTING AND THE LEVEL IS STILL NOT REVIVED, because the rule that forbids raising a limit to chase a name that got away contains no exception for names that kept going. RE-GRADED AT 13:21 AND THE GAP HAS NARROWED FOR THE FIRST TIME: TGT is 163.13 bid / 163.18 ask at 17:22:08.067096689Z, +3.08% against the 158.25 close, on a 0.031% spread - the tightest quote on the board. That is 1.21 above the 161.92 this board refused at 09:46, DOWN from 2.19 above an hour ago, having given back 0.98 from the 164.11 the 12:21 run recorded. Against the 159.36 level killed yesterday it is 3.77 above, worth 7.54 on the 2 shares that spec carried against 9.50 an hour ago. THE REFUSAL IS COSTING LESS THAN IT WAS AND THE LEVEL IS STILL NOT REVIVED, because a name drifting back toward a level the board already declined is not a new entry on new quotes - it is the same thesis waiting for permission, and the rule contains no exception for names that come partway back either.
entryWatch.why: THIS IS THE REFUSAL THAT COST SOMETHING AND IT IS RECORDED WHERE THE RETRO CAN GRADE IT. On the tape alone TGT is the best entry on this board today: better structure than FUTU, a verified 9.3% beat where FUTU's consensus cannot even be pulled, and a 0.278% spread against FUTU's 0.449%. It is refused anyway. docs/RULES.md, in the 2026-08-18 change, says the limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away and that re-striking a dead level higher is the behaviour this board has refused most often. Yesterday this board wrote 159.36, killed it deliberately at 14:22 on a drought test, and watched the 15:22 run report that the kill had cost sixty cents before the 15:36 run reported that the same kill had saved sixty-two. Today the stock is 2.56 through that level. Writing TGT now at 161.92 is not a new entry on new quotes - it is the same thesis at a higher price after the name moved away, which is the definition of the thing the rule forbids. YESTERDAY'S OWN STATE FILE SAID TOMORROW'S OPEN MAY WRITE TGT AGAIN ON TOMORROW'S QUOTES, AND THAT SENTENCE LOSES TO THE RULEBOOK, which is authority and is categorical. A test that binds only when honouring it is free is not a test, and the AS row on this same board has refused a revival four sessions running on exactly this reasoning. If TGT runs from here the record will show this board named it, ranked it second, and declined it on a written rule rather than missing it.

entryWatch.setup: ROST post-earnings day 1 off a 46% EPS beat - the largest verified beat on the 8/19-8/21 calendar, ranked third and passed over on item 2
entryWatch.trigger: QUOTED 238.38 bid / 238.90 ask at 13:45:54.376Z, last 239.00, +4.10% against the 228.99 settled close, on a 0.218% spread - the tightest on the board. Reported 8/20 AFTER the close at 2.66 EPS against a 1.82 estimate, a 46.2% beat, verified live. IT IS DAY 1 AND IT IS ALREADY FADING: it opened 243.85, made its high at 243.86 in the first minutes, and has given back 5.48 to trade 238.38 - so the entry available now is below the open on a session that is rolling over rather than extending. RE-GRADED AT 13:21: ROST is 241.26 bid / 241.37 ask at 17:22:06.541696561Z, +5.36% against the 228.99 close, on a 0.046% spread. It is now 2.88 above the 238.38 it was refused at, against 1.77 an hour ago, and it has recovered nearly the whole of the day-1 fade the 09:46 note rested on - 2.60 below the 243.86 session high against 5.48 below it at the refusal. THAT WEAKENS ONE OF THE TWO ORIGINAL OBJECTIONS AND IS RECORDED AS DOING SO: the fade-in-progress reading has not held. Item 2 is unchanged, because today is still the spike day, and item 5 is unchanged, because four retail beats sold this week is a fact about the tape rather than about ROST's price. A day-2 or day-3 entry after this digests remains the only shape that could qualify.
entryWatch.why: TWO INDEPENDENT REASONS, AND THE SECOND IS THE ONE THAT DECIDED IT. Item 2 refuses it first: today IS the spike day, the rulebook says in as many words that better entries are the day-2/3 pullback after strength rather than the spike, and a gap-up that has already surrendered 5.48 off its own opening print is a fade in progress, not a continuation. The gap is also into overhead supply - ROST traded 248.25 on 8/12 and fell eight straight sessions into this print, so every buyer from the last two weeks is above today's price. ITEM 5 IS THE STRONGER OBJECTION AND IT IS THE LESSON OF THIS ENTIRE WEEK. ROST is the fifth retail beat on this tape in three sessions and the first four were sold: WMT beat by 9.5% and fell 8.59%, AAP beat by 27% and lost a fifth of the company, TJX beat and fell two consecutive sessions, LOW beat by two cents and faded. TGT is the only retail beat that has paid. A 46% beat is not evidence the tape will pay for it when the four most recent comparables in the same complex were all sold - that is precisely the mechanism item 5 exists to name. Recorded as the strongest alternative on catalyst and liquidity and the weakest on setup, so a day-2 or day-3 entry after this digests is the only shape that could ever qualify.

A name up 6.45% today on day 3, having already run 10.8% in two sessions and trading 5.06 above the 78.45 close and 7.24 above the 76.27 day-2 high the 8/20 open recorded, is being bought after the move by any reading of the rule. THE HONEST PART GOES ON THE RECORD REGARDLESS: this board ranked SQM second on 8/20, passed it over, and it has now beaten the chosen name on every single check across two days. That is written here rather than quietly dropped, because a ranking that reports only its flattering hours is not a record. The process half is unchanged and is not revised by the outcome - a thin book on the day of the decision was a thin book, and item 2 refuses it independently today at a price 5.06 higher.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, broken on its own written level and not revived
entryWatch.trigger: QUOTED 32.54 bid / 32.56 ask, +0.03% against the 32.53 settled close - flat, and going nowhere for a second session. That is 1.16 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance and 1.33 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted.
entryWatch.why: FIFTH CONSECUTIVE SESSION OF THE SAME ANSWER AND IT IS THE ROW THAT MAKES TODAY'S TGT REFUSAL CREDIBLE RATHER THAN CONVENIENT. The higher low the day-2 thesis rested on broke at 33.70 and nothing since has rebuilt it; the stock has now spent two sessions flat on the floor instead of basing. A level may not be revived because the name came back toward it after the structure broke - and today the same principle was applied to TGT pointed the other way, refusing a level because the name ran AWAY from it. Both are the board declining to let subsequent price action rewrite a decision it already made in writing, and a board that applied that only when the refusal was free would be applying nothing.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 4 with a first green session
entryWatch.trigger: QUOTED 14.44 bid / 14.46 ask, +3.14% against the 14.00 settled close - the FIRST up session after three consecutive down days, and the first print back above the 14.32 level this row has carried all week. Volume is 1,429,585 in twelve minutes against a 9,621,267 two-week average.
entryWatch.why: ONE GREEN DAY IS NOT A BASE AND THIS ROW IS NOT UPGRADED ON IT. The precondition written here every session has been a base, and a single reclaim of a level on the fourth day after a 22.5% collapse is the first candidate for one, not the thing itself. It stays on the board as the live counterexample that stops item 1 decaying into a number came out: KLAR beat on 8/18 and lost a fifth of the company, AS beat the same morning and is flat five sessions later, WMT and AAP beat this week and were sold hard. Four beats, no follow-through - which is the evidence item 5 rests on and the reason FUTU was tested against positioning rather than waved through on its print.

entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A TWENTY-FIFTH TIME. QUOTED 37.14 bid / 37.17 ask, +1.75% against the 36.50 settled close. The dead 38.24 limit is 1.07 above the offer. Best spread on the board at 0.081%.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK WAS NEVER THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND TWENTY-FIVE READINGS HAVE NOW SUPPLIED THE PROOF IN EVERY DIRECTION - through the limit, far below it, and everywhere between. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5, with the 8/11 print now eight sessions back and its own written buy condition unmet, and SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/19-8/26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board for liquidity alone.
